svg.text: What is shown, and what is not
quantum-cortex, original figure. Every number of this section has a row in docs/RESULTS.md with the file that produced it and a test that recomputes it;
everything at 27 million parameters, on synthetic facts built to be leak proof and written by the system's author; no natural text, no benchmark score
The organ alone stores, returns and forgets

g.text: planted episodes return by their address after the
process that wrote them has ended, on four seeds,
and nothing returns for an entity never planted
by the text of a question the organ alone is at
chance: it is an index, not a language
an eviction withdraws the episode's address from
the memory, nothing kept moved

svg.text: The system holds on its own family of facts

g.text: with the organ's index geometry adopted and its mark
on every line of the window, the model with the organ
retrieves the right episode on every question and
answers strictly on the share of them row 47 states,
on the two seeds that did not conceive the policy, with
no invalid citation and no claim on a never planted entity
a near duplicate written to the journal is admitted
under an identity rule and never cited in place of
the original under the adopted selection rule
on formulations outside the templates it was trained
on, the four frozen conditions hold on no cell; read against
the organ's own mark, the mark reproduces the selection the
protocol rewards; the model's measured contribution is its
copy and its abstention
against the simplest references the organ's stack is not
separated at this size (by vacuity, letter R-b): the read side
brings no measured advantage; the write side was compared
with no reference, and no advantage is claimed
